title: Guided tour from the bee to the bottle and tasting - French
blurb:
Welcome to our urban farm! Apikol is an urban agriculture distillery located in downtown Quebec. Guided tours are led by one of the beekeeper and distiller co-owners. You will be fascinated by the world of bees during the observation of bees at work in our hive (4 seasons). Afterwards, you will discover how we make our artisanal alcohols from our honey.
It all ends with the tasting of our alcohols.
